page.overview:
Who is Brian Fee Clamp?

Brian Fee Clamp is a minor character in Cars.

Brian and Artie watch the footage of the tie-breaker race between Lightning McQueen, Chick Hicks, and Strip Weathers in a booth at the Los Angeles International Speedway. The two are surprised when they notice Doc Hudson as McQueen's crew chief, as he, previously known as the Fabulous Hudson Hornet, had not been seen in years.
